traits.name: Infused Items
traits.text: An ifrit pyrochemist carries the following infused items, which last for 24 hours or until the next time the pyrochemist makes their daily preparations: lesser alchemist's fire (5), lesser elixir of life (2), lesser smokestick.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: alchemist's tools, dagger, flint and steel, formula book, studded leather;

traits.name: Quick Bomber
traits.text: ⬻ The ifrit pyrochemist draws an alchemical bomb with an Interact action and throws it as a ranged Strike.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +8 (agile, finesse, thrown 10 feet, versatile s); Damage 1d4 (1d4) piercing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ lesser alchemist's fire +8 (range increment 30 feet); Damage 1d8 (1d8) fire plus 1 persistent fire damage and 1 fire splash damage
